purpose: Advance the OZ positioning question from the fund layer (resolved null) to the LAND layer: which designated tracts had an already-owned parcel/project positioned before the June 14 2018 designation, and by what nomination path? The fund vehicle is a red herring (oz-run-...-02/03); this is where the signal lives.

bounded_denominator.definition: OZ tracts that appear in public oversight or major investigative reporting as investor- or donor-connected — an enumerable, receipt-bounded seed set, NOT 'all ~8,764 tracts'.
bounded_denominator.why_bounded: A full per-tract sweep is a per-county photonic problem (recorder deed viewers) with no cheap adapter. The honest first slice is the documented set, which is finite, receipted, and lets us build the candidate schema and coverage discipline before scaling.
explicitly_out_of_scope: private-individual dossiers beyond what the cited public reporting states
any assertion of illegality — designation of owned land is lawful; oversight bodies adjudicate

spine_to_run.output: already-owned parcel/project as reported; county-recorder deed = the still-photonic verification gap
who nominated it (governor discretion), any reported lobbying, whether the state originally intended to pick it
ownership/project date vs June 14 2018 designation anchor
any IG/Congressional inquiry touching the instance

adapters.status: NOT WIRED — this is the remaining photonic gap; per-county JS viewers, no UA trick. Coverage stays not_searched until built.

tiering: Per docs/tiered-research-methodology.md. Sonnet does the reporting synthesis (judgment over open sources); Fable+human verify receipts + apply the forbidden-inference gate; nothing promotes past candidate_only.

epistemic_contract.forbidden_inference: Documenting that an owned parcel sits in a designated tract is a structural observation, never a claim of wrongdoing. Cite reporting/oversight; do not conclude beyond them.

exit_criteria.start: enumerate the documented seed set into candidate_only rows with verified receipts and honest coverage (deed layer = not_searched).
exit_criteria.done_for_this_slice: every seed instance has: tract identity, reported pre-designation ownership, nomination path, temporal screen vs 2018-06-14, oversight status, >=1 verified receipt.
exit_criteria.not_in_this_slice: county-recorder deed verification (needs the photonic adapter), full-tract enumeration, promotion to finding, Genesis seal.
